description: Extract data across multiple pages in a single call. Handles click-next, infinite scroll, and URL-pattern pagination. Auto-detects 'next' buttons when nextSelector='auto'. Returns extracted content from each page plus metadata. Replaces 3-4 tool calls per page with one invocation. Cap: 50 pages, 100K total chars.

delayMs.description: Delay between pages in ms. Default: 1000.

extractTarget.description: CSS selector to scope extraction to a specific container.

extractType.description: What to extract from each page.

maxCharsPerPage.description: Max characters per page extraction. Default: 5000.

nextSelector.description: CSS selector for the next button, or 'auto' to detect automatically.

paginationType.description: Pagination strategy: click (next button), scroll (infinite scroll), url (URL pattern).

urlPattern.description: URL pattern with {page} placeholder for paginationType='url'.

name: paginate
title: Pagination Extraction
